disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving dishonesty or directly related to the practice of electrology
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction by plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or sentencing, including, but not limited to, convictions, preceding sentences of supervision, conditional discharge, or first offender probation, under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States that is (i) a felony or (ii) a misdemeanor, an essential element of which is dishonesty, or that is directly related to the practice of electrology.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license under this Act, or in connection with applying for renewal of a license under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of controlled substances, alcohol, or other substances impairing practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs defined in law as controlled substances, alcohol, or any other substance that results in an electrologist's inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another governmental agency, unit of government, US jurisdiction, or foreign nation for substantially equivalent grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another governmental agency, unit of government, U.S. jurisdiction, or foreign nation if at least one of the grounds for discipline is the same as or substantially equivalent to any of those set forth in this Act.

definition_quote.value: "Electrology" means the practice or teaching of services for permanent hair removal utilizing only solid probe electrode type epilation, which may include thermolysis (shortwave, high frequency), electrolysis (galvanic), or a combination of both (superimposed or sequential blend).
definition_quote.quote: "Electrology" means the practice or teaching of services for permanent hair removal utilizing only solid probe electrode type epilation, which may include thermolysis (shortwave, high frequency), electrolysis (galvanic), or a combination of both (superimposed or sequential blend).

methods_authorized.quote: The use of a sterile needle/probe electrode type epilation, which includes (i) electrolysis, known as direct current/DC, (ii) thermolysis, known as alternating current/AC, or (iii) a combination of both electrolysis and thermolysis, known as superimposed or sequential blend.

drug_authority.value: Electrologists may apply antiseptic on the treatment area; they are not authorized to perform surgery or use laser technology except when delegated by a physician.
drug_authority.quote: The application of an antiseptic on the area of the individual's skin to which electrology will be applied.

hair_removal_modalities_authorized.quote: thermolysis (shortwave, high frequency), electrolysis (galvanic), or a combination of both (superimposed or sequential blend)

needle_penetration_required.quote: utilizing only solid probe electrode type epilation

laser_prohibited.quote: Services involving laser technology may only be performed if they are delegated by a physician licensed to practice medicine in all its branches consistent with Section 20 of this Act and the Medical Practice Act of 1987
